name: AI Feature Film Production
description: Feature-length AI filmmaking as a governed production pipeline rather than a pile of unrelated clips.

tasks.name: Lock story package
tasks.objective: Finalize screenplay, scene numbering, character arcs, locations, props, chronology, production constraints, and change-control rules before expensive generation begins.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Screenplay and scene order are version-locked.
Character, location, prop, wardrobe, and timeline bibles exist.
Later story changes require explicit impact review.

tasks.name: Build shot map
tasks.objective: Convert every scene into structured shots with action, composition, lens language, movement, duration, dialogue, continuity dependencies, reference assets, and editorial purpose.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every beat needed by the locked screenplay has planned coverage.
Each shot declares continuity inputs and intended edit relationship.

tasks.name: Lock visual identities
tasks.objective: Create multi-angle character plates, expression/wardrobe references, environment plates, prop sheets, palette rules, and reusable reference packages. Prefer reference-driven identity controls over seed superstition.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Recurring characters and locations have reusable reference sets.
Continuity-critical visual attributes are explicit and testable.

tasks.name: Generate production batches
tasks.objective: Generate shots in continuity-aware batches, preferably grouped by location, lighting setup, wardrobe state, and adjacent edit context. Use the strongest available reference-driven video model per shot and preserve generation provenance.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every generated shot traces to its shot specification and references.
Rejected takes retain failure notes so retries change one variable at a time.

tasks.name: Continuity and edit QC
tasks.objective: Compare neighboring shots for identity, eyelines, screen direction, lighting, wardrobe, prop state, geography, motion, temporal logic, and cut compatibility. Flag only concrete defects and route repairs to the smallest affected shots.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Adjacent shots pass continuity checks or have repair tickets.
No repair requires regenerating unaffected scenes.

tasks.name: Build layered audio
tasks.objective: Produce dialogue, ambience, effects, Foley, room tone, and score as separable stems. Lock recurring voices from approved references and maintain scene-level loudness and sync notes.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dialogue, effects, ambience, and music remain independently editable.
Recurring voices are checked for identity drift.

tasks.name: Conform and master
tasks.objective: Assemble in a traditional NLE, lock picture, grade consistently, repair temporal artifacts, mix audio, add titles/captions, run full-film continuity review, and export archival plus delivery masters.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Picture lock matches the screenplay and shot map.
Final continuity review spans scene boundaries, not only individual shots.
Master, captions, stems, and source provenance are preserved.
